_: The exact evidence this console is willing to publish. The sibling checkout is byte transport; THIS is the pin. If evalmut regenerates the artifact without an intentional update here, the sha256 stops the build. public_url is what makes the pin checkable by a reader instead of only by the author, and it is addressed at pinned_commit, never at issuer_commit: the two are different facts. issuer_commit is the code state the run was stamped at and is cross-checked against the artifact's own stamp. pinned_commit is the commit whose tree actually contains these bytes, which is normally a later one, because a run is made first and its artifact is committed afterwards. Addressing the URL at the issuer commit sent readers to a tree where the file did not yet have these bytes.
